notes.title: Update 1.4.1!
notes.notes:
I finally have the holidays and I was able to devote more time to finalizing the new update, which you can try right now!

After updating the main menu in the last update 1.4, unfortunately I neglected the loading screen. It still reminded me of the old game design from the demo version. I finally got around to redesigning it. The loading screen got a new stylish design, as well as a new loading progress bar, which I had a hard developing time with because of the difficulties with the game constructor used.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38971015/17b375baf3f1974d8c6f39321b9ba12f7b5298e1.png[/img]



By popular demand, the German language has been added! This seems to have been the most difficult part of the update. There were 1000+ lines of all the text in the game translated. Since I don't speak German, I had to use machine translation, but I tried to translate every line back and check if it made sense. Since there is no functionality for measuring the width of the lines in the game, I had to manually adjust each line to fit the frame of the panels in the game by putting "\n" and "-\n".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38971015/399475b1454fe6cf0dccd36352ce78f0326309c1.png[/img]


Also:
[list]
[*] A parameter with the font used has been added to the beginning of each localization file. All lines in the game will accept the selected font. At the request of one of the players, a second font, Nanum Square Round, has been embedded.

[*] The efficiency of the heat exchangers has been reduced to 90%. The change is designed to get rid of the strange behavior of keeping the sectors at the expense of energy storage overcrowding.

[*] Fixed a bug that allowed any target reseach to be transferred to other saves that did not have a target research selected.
[/list]
And other small changes. I hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Update 1.4!
notes.notes:
After many months the long delayed update is finally out! A complete redesign of the main menu and save system along with the exams took an unexpectedly long time to implement, but it's over now.

[b]Meet the new main menu![/b] Down with the old incompatible design and hello to the rounded corners! In addition, it is also a full-fledged pause, you get all its functionality without leaving the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38971015/93882516b331bdea3e8e65405190c1f7c31705c2.png[/img]



The new main menu has opened the way for in-game settings and the [b]new save system[/b]!
As written above, settings can now be changed during the game. The design has been improved, and there are new, more convenient controls: the toggle, the multi-switch, and the volume slider! To the right of the settings themselves is now a preview of the changes, straight from the alpha version of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38971015/3b102bdae008b1ca8ac614765cea9db9023781e9.png[/img]



The new save system allows you to create an unlimited number of save slots, overwrite existing slots, make auto-saves and quick saves. There is also a button to navigate to the save folder to make it easier for you to navigate and change between them. Similarly to the settings menu, there is also a preview here, but with company statistics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38971015/a7df5927f2e60f1388ccacf5533665db70ab8725.png[/img]



New game menu updated: in addition to the name of the company, the name of the owner and the difficulty of the game appeared modifiers! Now you can get a million marks at the start of the game, unlock all the research, unlock all the plots and slow down your competitors! For convenience, there are tabs to switch between company settings and game difficulty.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38971015/362b9a24e44218bf59d07231917fb38b33cd5e4f.png[/img]



There is an assistant for contracts now! Now you can see the content of the contract in a simplified and standardized way: import, export, status and dates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38971015/9c11e288c31c517843d73f160d343b039e401634.png[/img]



And also rebalanced the game, improved the savings account, fixed some bugs, expanded the interactive guide, increased sharpness on the edges of panels and other changes. I hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Notifications and other improvements
notes.notes:
Previously, the error notification was a single sound, but now this sound will be accompanied by full notifications with an icon and a description of the problem! Not enough money, an unavailable feature or a closed detail - the new notifications will warn you about all of this.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38971015/9ce97a1e85ec7e8280585d9072ea33a4913c1f04.png[/img]


Facilities and resources have gotten new counters. You will now be able to see the number of buildings built, resources stored and their limits!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38971015/c62c1fdc8129e97f359d8aab9f375bb396a5c617.png[/img]


Duration of contracts increased by ~50%, simplified difficulty made even easier, an indicator of running out of fuel appeared, added particles next to the selected research, introduced pause exit by pressing Space, now to accept and refuse a contract you must press and hold the appropriate buttons, and fixed some bugs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38971015/d52d071c91d25c7fb2cc0ba528051506254992b4.png[/img]

notes.title: Interactive guide
notes.notes:
By popular demand of players, interactive guide has been added, now you can build your own power plant without taking your eyes off the game! A moving window will tell you what you need to do, and a pointer will show you exactly what you need to interact with. Even if you happen to veer off course, a pointer will show you how to go back!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38971015/a84fbf0a674abfd70c749fbdbd35f39d99df3292.png[/img]

The steam has been refined and also got a new height-dependent parallax effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38971015/3918d3a835df71688bdc6dd59b00735578a8dcea.png[/img]

There is a new panel with information about the customer's company. You can now see his rating, distance, and power loss calculation. To fully meet the requirements of the contract, you will have to compensate for losses with slightly higher power deliveries.

In previous updates, there is an indicator with the power supply calculation from the total amount, and the power supply description item has been changed to make it clearer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38971015/c2e72a4900e8d320171d702063677464b610b1e4.png[/img]

Simplified difficulty will not allow the world to evolve any faster than your power plant. In this mode, you can forget about the competition and develop the power plant at your own pace!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38971015/775ba1c8d3ddab5288f8e5996711c85c9d6d29d8.png[/img]

notes.title: REACTOR TECH² IS OUT!
notes.notes:
Yay! I just released the game! It was hard, but I think I pulled it off.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38971015/a2a9bdd397fd64db28f055ee8a52dd73923af020.png[/img]

And here is the hero of the occasion — the third generation power unit — the nuclear power plant unit!
The long-awaited nuclear reactor has been added! Now Reactor Tech² fully lives up to its name and you can install nuclear reactors in your power units.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38971015/e20ec4fa70b219e36ba5e450128379680874f67e.png[/img]

Three types of reactor were added: water-water reactor, boiling water reactor, and channel reactor. In addition, the first neutron reflector, a coal boiler, and two new turbines were added: a twin and a twin-cylinder. In the future, I plan to add at least one more reactor and a couple of neutron reflectors. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38971015/01878392d9a814dacae615b1940de4d97671708c.png[/img]

A completely new research tree is before your eyes! It has become times larger (currently 80 nodes) and more complex — research points and research experience have been added. In addition, your competitors can be seen on the right, in the screenshot they are few, but every year their number increases! To become the most popular company will have to struggle, or maybe not, suddenly it will be easy?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38971015/b1975326e80fc082655d22c5a33e38dbcd7bc43b.png[/img]

And the highlight on the cake is the new full-screen detailed tutorial! It's not finished yet, and right now there's only the bare essentials, but I'll have more sections and paragraphs with useful information about the mechanics of the game soon. Thanks for listening, I'm very excited for the game's release!

notes.title: Graphics, competitors, and endings
notes.notes:
There have been quite a few changes in these two months. Improved graphics, redesigned pause interface, added competitors, contracts, and endings. About everything in order.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38971015/d6bd97f39a11ecd0cf777ee21fb46a5e10c105f7.jpg[/img]

[h3]New graphics[/h3]
Trees and bushes have been redesigned. They will no longer raise questions about their size against the background of buildings and power lines. The grass has lost its excessive sharpness and has become more smoothed. Vignetting is no longer so sharp, now it will only darken the image at the corners. The overall picture has become more natural and pleasant.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38971015/dc0016128f8210eb6e6125b9a978093816b6fc5f.jpg[/img]

[h3]Competition[/h3]
Meet: a new chart, as well as a table of companies that switch to any statistics that you are interested in. Now competitors exist, and they are also developing with you. In the full version, you can compete with dozens of major power engineers or hundreds of nameless ones. At the end of the century, the best will be chosen!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38971015/2c8a52ab845d952ca29485f3fda05f7a656026cf.jpg[/img]

[h3]Researches[/h3]
The description window has been moved to the right panel. Now it will not overlap with other research nodes. In the new description window, there are useful indicators of implementation and experience.

The implementation shows the price of the technology. For it to work, you will have to pay money to implement it. You don't have to implement the research to keep opening the next research in the same branch.

The experience indicator shows the amount of experience required to open a research. Even if you don't have enough experience, you will still be able to discover the technology. The progress of the discovery will slow down as much as if you were doing another research in addition to the selected research, which gives you the missing experience points. From now on, it will be extremely pointless to develop a single branch.

After opening the research, you can sell it to companies that do not have it. You will earn money, but you will give a head start to your competitors. Whether to do so is up to you.

In addition to selling the research, you can also buy it. If the research is open to most power engineers, you can buy it, but it will not give you the experience you need to open other researches.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38971015/b2a4682f8fb854eea46b58c3a5ea33bd9430fa56.jpg[/img]

[h3]Contracts[/h3]
Full-fledged contracts have replaced the boring scale of electricity exports! Now, instead of adjusting the scale, you will have to study the content of the contract, and then calculate your strength.

In the section of new contracts will appear.. new contracts. The number of slots is limited. New contracts will move the old ones to the next slot, and the last ones will simply disappear. You can fix the desired contract so that it does not disappear or clear the slots by throwing out non-interesting contracts.

After signing the contract, it is transferred to the active contracts section, whose slots are also limited. When the contract is activated, it will export some resource specified in it (so far only electricity). After completing the contract, you will be given a reward. If you break your contract or fail to fulfill it, you will receive a fine and lose your reputation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38971015/8d772ad6aa9e9ab663cd64827643d453a9156788.jpg[/img]

[h3]Endings[/h3]
Now you can lose. No more playing with zero reputation or a giant credit will not work — the corresponding ending will be called.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38971015/290f76a42d0db843132b180fad2a3dccfd1e2553.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New right panel
notes.notes:
I am currently updating interface in the game. I've almost finished working on the right panel, which includes several different sections.

[h3]ARCHITECTURE[/h3]
In addition to being compact, the menu has become more functional. Now you can hide the unnecessary things in the game, for example, the display of closed territories. To open a closed area, you need to use a new tool designed for this purpose.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38971015/f0d591ba4d75a8e72e30b4ba48b6bf6d25671bdb.png[/img]

[h3]RESOURCES[/h3]
Resources are divided by type. For each type, you can choose different resource (in the demo version, you could only choose 1 for all). You can fix the number of resources and it will be automatically bought or sold when there is a shortage or excess. The more resources you order from the company, the more loyal it will be to you, lowering the price for your product. The capacity of each resource type is limited, and you will have to build and improve warehouses to be able to stock up on a large number of resources.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38971015/172f94113914660616395773d5a08adf098bd19f.png[/img]

[h3]ENGINEERING[/h3]
The engineering menu has undergone many changes. For the sake of compactness, you will only see the power unit that you have selected. Added tools that provide statistics by sector, allowing you to turn off a specific sector or buy a new part.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38971015/49034e12126e8ab328e0025b084cea2833d9aadd.png[/img]

[h3]ABOUT THE PLANS[/h3]
My plans are to redo the control panel, replace the mechanics of selling electricity with the addition of full-fledged contracts that will be offered during the game. Third-generation power plants will be added to allow the use of nuclear reactors. There will also be different endings, depending on how you play, for example, when you lose your reputation, an explosion of a nuclear power unit, or after 100 game years.
